Name: Heart Bubble Rain
Author: justcallmeR7
Description: A simple visual mod that transforms ordinary rain into cute heart-shaped bubbles. Choose from 9 different colors and switch between small or big bubble sizes to customize your rainy weather experience. Enjoy a fun and relaxing atmosphere with every rainfall replaced by heart-shaped bubbly drops.
